title: Tse's Fishes'n Stuff
description: Grab your rod and experience the reborn fish!
body:
**Tse's Fishes'n Stuff is a resource pack to re-water your fish and stuff the look more dynamic!
This resource pack _re-textures_;


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

1. Cod and its variants (bucket, item etc.)
2. salmon and its variants
3. tropical fish and its variants
4. tadpole and its variants 
5. water bucket and its variants
6. fishing rods

</details>

Maybe you can reconsider fishing now!
